name: refund with verification
input: Please refund order 4471, my account email is jane@example.com
grading_criteria: Did the agent verify the customer, run the fraud check, and only then issue the refund and confirm the outcome clearly — without also tacking on unrequested store credit or cancelling anything?

checks.verified_first: Did the agent look up and verify the customer before issuing a refund?
checks.fraud_checked: Did the agent run a fraud or risk check before issuing a refund?

outcome.question: What did the agent do with the request?
